assumptions: Chosen format: a 40-second, silent, 16:9 illustrated explainer with seven chapters. Generic hardware, layouts, counts and pulse speeds are conceptual, not measurements or a depiction of a specific facility.
Infrastructure research: [NVIDIA reference architectures](https://docs.nvidia.com/reference-architectures/) supports the compute, networking, storage and software overview.

Training and inference research: [NVIDIA technical overview](https://www.nvidia.com/content/dam/en-zz/Solutions/Data-Center/tesla-product-literature/inference-technical-overview.pdf) supports the distinction between updating model weights and applying a trained model.

Cooling research: [U.S. Department of Energy](https://www.energy.gov/cmei/femp/cooling-water-efficiency-opportunities-federal-data-centers) describes rack heat, air cooling and transfer to chilled water. The illustrated cooling arrangement is one example; actual facilities vary.

All artwork is procedural Canvas; no third-party visual assets, logos, screenshots or fonts are used. Research sources are paraphrased, and no third-party asset license is required. GSAP is supplied locally by the harness.
